# ConvertHub

> ConvertHub — convert PDF, video and audio online free. 57 free tools.
> PDF converter, video converter and audio converter. Convert PDF to JPG,
> MP4 to MP3, MP3 to WAV and more, in your browser, no uploads.
> Files never leave your device. Files up to 100 MB.

## Links

- [ConvertHub](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/)
- [Sitemap](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Tools

### PDF

- [PDF to JPG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert PDF pages to JPG images
- [PDF to PNG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert PDF pages to PNG images
- [PDF to Word](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert PDF to Word
- [PDF to Text](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): extract text from PDF
- [Merge PDF](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): merge multiple PDFs
- [Rotate PDF](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): rotate PDF pages
- [PDF Compressor](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): compress PDF files
- [JPG to PDF](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert JPG images to PDF
- [Image to PDF](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert images to PDF

### Video

- [MP4 to MP3](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): extract audio from MP4 video
- [MP4 to WAV](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert MP4 video to WAV audio
- [Video Converter](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert between video formats
- [Video Compressor](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): compress video files
- [Video Resizer](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): resize video dimensions

### Audio

- [Audio Converter](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert between audio formats
- [MP3 to WAV](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert MP3 to WAV
- [WAV to MP3](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert WAV to MP3
- [M4A to MP3](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert M4A to MP3
- [OGG to MP3](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert OGG to MP3
- [FLAC to MP3](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert FLAC to MP3
- [Audio Compressor](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): compress audio files

### Image

- [JPG to PNG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert JPG to PNG
- [PNG to JPG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert PNG to JPG
- [WebP to JPG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert WebP to JPG
- [HEIC to JPG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert HEIC to JPG
- [AVIF to JPG](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert AVIF to JPG
- [Image Converter](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): convert between image formats
- [Image Compressor](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): compress images, including to
  20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB and 500 KB targets
- [Resize Image](https://converthub-tools.vercel.app/): resize by pixels, cm, mm or inches,
  crop square or custom, rotate, change DPI, passport photos

## Notes

- All conversion runs locally in the browser; no file uploads.
- Free to use; no account needed.
